paragraphs: R' Reuven. ‘Resembles a son of the gods’: Reuven said that at that moment an angel descended and struck him on the mouth; Jerusalem Talmud, end of Ba-Meh Ishah. Rav Bibi in his name. He asked R' Mana: Jerusalem Talmud, end of Almanah Nizonet. R' Pinhas in his name: Midrash Shmuel, chapter 5; see there. R' Pinhas bar Hama in his name. He sent in R' Yohanan's name: Menahot 57b. In Rashi, however, it is ‘Ravin in R' Yohanan's name.’ It is likely a scribal error in the Gemara, for we frequently find ‘Ravin said in R' Yohanan's name.’ [Glosses: Reuven. Menahot 57b: R' Reuven in R' Yohanan's name; in Rashi: Ravin. Not corrected [ל״ת, provisional reading].]
